[PHASE:task_mapping]
The plan is specific enough to enter task mapping. Generate Tasks from Chat should now produce seven tasks for audience, messaging, SEO, editorial, briefs, distribution, and KPI tracking.
Please tighten the KPI task so it explicitly covers source systems and the weekly reporting cadence.
